author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Research PLTR in depth - browse the stock page, check recent news headlines, and read at least one article. Share your analysis as a comment on the news article. Also email a research note analyzing the technical setup and key support/resistance levels to raj.patel@asiaequity.com. Include PLTR's market capitalization (as shown on the stock page) in the email. Mention PLTR's EPS figure in your research note. Reference PLTR's 52-week low in the analysis.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a defense and AI analyst at Cypress Wealth Management. You cover the government technology and AI sector and provide research-driven investment analysis to clients. Your work follows the firm's research compliance framework, which requires thorough due diligence, balanced analysis of both opportunities and risks, and clear sourcing of all claims. You have access to tools that let you browse stock data, news, portfolio information, and send communications.
Current date and time: Monday, December 1, 2025, 1:30 PM ET (market open, mid-day trading session).
eval_task:
def eval_task(self, agent_responses=None):
        """Check: email sent to correct recipient + comment posted + data grounding."""
        msgs = search_messages(token=self.gmail_token, to_address="raj.patel@asiaequity.com")
        email_ok = len(msgs) > 0
        try:
            comments = self.finance.get_comments()
            comment_posted = len(comments or []) > 0
        except Exception:
            comment_posted = False
        # Data-grounding checks on email body
        body = ""
        if msgs:
            body = get_message_body(self.gmail_token, (msgs[0].get("ID") or msgs[0].get("id") or ""))
        body_lower = body.lower()
        mcap_mentioned = "443b" in body_lower
        eps_mentioned = any(kw.lower() in body_lower for kw in ['0.43'])
        low52w_mentioned = any(kw.lower() in body_lower for kw in ['63.4', '63.40'])
        data_ok = mcap_mentioned and eps_mentioned and low52w_mentioned
        ok = email_ok and comment_posted and data_ok
        return ok, {"email_sent": email_ok, "messages_found": len(msgs), "comment_posted": comment_posted, "mcap_mentioned": mcap_mentioned, "eps_mentioned": eps_mentioned, "low52w_mentioned": low52w_mentioned, "data_grounded": data_ok}
